notes.title: Version 1.5 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone V1.5 is here, these are the latest updates & fixes now live.

[list]
[*]Added 10 Achievements
[*]Fixed - dialogue text not fitting on smaller screen sizes (smaller than 1920×1080)
[*]Fixed - pause menu didn't fit for smaller screen sizes
[*]Player controller smoothness significantly reduced
[*]Fixed - Scene 10 pause menu brightness slider appears on all menus
[*]Drunken Weasel music change
[/list]

Thank you for all the support and have a great day :D

notes.title: Version 1.4 Update
notes.content:
Here are the latest fixes now live.

- Mansion scene player getting stuck in a room bug is now fixed.
- Title screen lighting fix.

Thank you for all the support and have a great day :D

notes.title: Version 1.3 Update
notes.content:
Here are the latest fixes now live.

- The player now has a longer reach, you don't need to stand as close to use doors, light switches etc.

- The large Mansion scene now helps players find their way around much easier (but not too much).

- The Drunken Weasel pub music change.

- Dialogue fixes

- Performance upgrades.

Thank you for all the support and have a great day :D

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Here are the latest fixes now live.

- Players can no longer walk through a certain bookcase in the mansion scene and skip a small section of the game.

- Players can no longer finish the mansion scene with only 5 keys.

- Performance upgrades.

Thank you for all the support and have a great day :D
